title.narrative: The capacity of the mutlifaceted Bangsamoro Justice System to adjudicate litigation is enhanced and aligned with international human rights standards.

description.narrative: The legal and regulatory framework and structure that supports a justice system that is multifaceted is established and institutionalised. The capacity of the Bangsamoro justice institutions to resolve disputes, including through the use of mediation and conciliation, and dispense justice that is consistent with international human rights standards and procedure is strengthened. Citizens, especially the most vulnerable and marginalised, are empowered to better assert and claim their rights through reforms and public communication campaigns coming from the justice system that will make it more inclusive.
